items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 03 October 2026 at 5:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

A ridge of high pressure now covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, backing South or Southwest later this afternoon and evening, then increasing 4 or 5 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 occasionally 6 from later tomorrow morning onwards, although staying a force or two lighter in Liverpool Bay.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy light rain.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any rain.
